title: Add headers to a libcurl request
summary: Pass headers built with curl_slist_append through CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, and free them after perform.

turns.user: post_json gets a 415 back. add Content-Type: application/json. also token isnt used yet, send it as Authorization: Bearer

assistant.body: Sure! With only CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS set, libcurl sends Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Custom headers go into a list, one line per curl_slist_append call, and the list is handed over with CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER. curl_slist_append copies the string, so auth can live on the stack. Once setopt has the list we're done with it, so it's freed right there with curl_slist_free_all.

assistant.body: Apologies, my previous answer was incorrect. libcurl copies each line of text, but it does not copy the list passed to CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER. The handle only keeps the pointer, so curl_easy_perform was walking a list that had already been freed. The free moves to after perform and cleanup. Looking again, there was a second hole: curl_slist_append returns NULL when it runs out of memory and leaves the old list alone, so assigning that straight to headers leaks every line added so far. A small helper frees the list on failure.
